tools.name: ping
tools.description: Checks that the RentalHunter connector can reach its inventory. Returns ok, the public hunt URL, and the privacy, terms, and support links.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists cities on RentalHunter, each city's budget currency, stay lengths, and the live USD rates.

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description: Searches RentalHunter inventory by city, locality, stay length, budget, and must-haves the seeker named. Set furnished true only when the seeker explicitly asks for furnished. Omit it for any furnishing. Locality is exact: Baner does not include Hinjewadi. Returns matching homes with local-currency

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns one RentalHunter listing by id: local-currency rent, locality, stay fit, furnishing (furnished, semi-furnished, unfurnished, or not specified), deposit, lock-in, verification badges, freshness, and the listing link. A missing or unavailable id returns found false and does not substitute anot

tools.name: save_hunt_alert
tools.description: Saves a hunt alert for this query after the seeker agrees to share their email with partners whose listings match, and emails them when a home matches. Requires consent true. Does not accept a phone number. A phone is shared later only on the website, and only with the partner whose property the see

tools.name: guided_rental_questionnaire
tools.description: Reports which hunt fields are still missing. When city, stay length, and budget are present, searches inventory. Does not save an alert or collect an email.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: Lists this partner's own homes with status, a verified flag, and counts of views, saves, matched hunts, and accepted hunts for the last 7 and 30 days. Requires a partner API token. Other partners' homes are never included.

tools.name: listing_performance
tools.description: Returns status, the verified flag, and 7- and 30-day counts for one home this partner owns. A home owned by someone else is reported as not in your inventory.

tools.name: my_leads
tools.description: Lists recent hunts that match this partner's homes. Seeker name and email stay hidden until this partner has already accepted that hunt. Phone numbers are never included.

tools.name: suggestions
tools.description: Suggests improvements for this partner's homes, such as a home with no photos or rent far above the local median for the same city and bedrooms.
